info.title: OceanAlt — compliance layer for agent payments
info.summary: Before your agent pays, call OceanAlt once.
info.description:
Four paid x402 operations for agent payments. POST /api/x402/decision returns allow, review or decline for one payee address, with the list, source and date behind any match and a signed receipt. GET /api/x402/trace follows USDT inflows on TRON. POST /api/x402/batch screens up to 25 addresses. POST /api/x402/credits buys 100 decision calls.

Payment: x402, USDC on Solana mainnet or Base. Unpaid requests return 402 with a machine-readable quote.

Human-readable fields default to English; pass lang=zh for Chinese. signal_keys is language-independent, so branch on it.

tags.name: free
tags.description: No API key, no signup. Fair-use rate limited.

tags.name: paid (x402)
tags.description: Pay-per-call over x402. Unpaid requests return 402 with a machine-readable quote.

post.description:
Same shape as /api/decide, plus x402 settlement ($0.002/call, or $0.10 for a 100-call credit pack). Unpaid requests get a 402 with a payment-required quote header.

Example:
curl -i -X POST "https://oceanalt.com/api/x402/decision" -H "content-type: application/json" -d '{"to":"0x…"}'

402.description: Payment required — the `payment-required` header carries the x402 v2 quote (accepts[]).

429.description: Rate limited (60 requests/min per IP). Honour `retry-after`.

parameters.name: X-OceanAlt-Credit
parameters.description: Optional. A credit token from POST /api/x402/credits. With it, the call uses one credit and needs no x402 payment; the response carries x-oceanalt-credits-remaining.

get.description:
Follows the largest inflows upstream, up to 3 hops, to see whether funds touched a listed address. Main path only, so no hit does not prove the address is clean. x402 settlement, $0.01 per call.

Example:
curl -i "https://oceanalt.com/api/x402/trace?addr=T…"

402.description: Payment required — the `payment-required` header carries the x402 v2 quote (accepts[]).

429.description: Rate limited (60 requests/min per IP). Honour `retry-after`.

post.description:
Screens up to 25 addresses in one call, with a verdict per address, sorted riskiest first. x402 settlement, $0.01 per call.

Example:
curl -i -X POST "https://oceanalt.com/api/x402/batch" -H "content-type: application/json" -d '{"addresses":["0x…","T…"]}'

addresses.description: Array of up to 25 addresses (0x or T)

402.description: Payment required — the `payment-required` header carries the x402 v2 quote (accepts[]).

429.description: Rate limited (60 requests/min per IP). Honour `retry-after`.

post.description:
One $0.10 payment buys 100 decision calls, valid 365 days. The response shows a token once; send it as the X-OceanAlt-Credit header on /api/x402/decision and each call uses one credit.

Example:
curl -i -X POST "https://oceanalt.com/api/x402/credits"

200.description: Credit pack bought: 100 decision calls. The token is shown once; store it. The pack activates when this payment settles.

credit_token.description: Send as header X-OceanAlt-Credit on POST /api/x402/decision. Shown only in this response.

402.description: Payment required — the `payment-required` header carries the x402 v2 quote (accepts[]).

429.description: Rate limited (60 requests/min per IP). Honour `retry-after`.

post.summary: A payment by one of your agents was blocked or flagged
post.description:
Sent to the webhook URL configured in the console (https://oceanalt.com/en/keys).

Signature (Standard Webhooks, https://www.standardwebhooks.com/): webhook-signature = "v1," + base64(HMAC-SHA256(key, webhook-id + "." + webhook-timestamp + "." + raw body)), where key is the base64-decoded part of the whsec_ secret after the prefix. Reject a webhook-timestamp more than 300 seconds from your clock. For 24 hours after a rotation the header carries two space-separated signatures; accept if either matches.

Delivery: answer 2xx within about 5 seconds. Redirects are not followed. Anything else is retried after 60, 300, 1800, 7200 seconds, up to 5 attempts in total, with the same webhook-id (deduplicate on it).

parameters.name: webhook-id
parameters.description: Unique message id, identical across retries.

parameters.name: webhook-timestamp
parameters.description: Unix seconds when this attempt was signed.

pillar.description: The gate that fired, e.g. Screening/AML.

2XX.description: Acknowledged. Any other outcome counts as a failed delivery and is retried.

post.summary: Test event sent from the console
post.description: Signed exactly like key-alert. Test events are not retried.

verdict.description: uncertain means screening could not run — never treat it as clear.

lang.description: Language the human-readable fields were rendered in.

signals.description: Human-readable risk signals, in the requested language.

signal_keys.description: Language-independent signal keys (e.g. list.mixer, taint.onehop). Branch on these, not on the prose.

evidence.description: Verifiable evidence: which list, label or on-chain path matched, with a link you can open yourself.

retry.description: Whether and under what condition an agent should retry.

allow.description: One-line branch for an agent: if (!allow) halt().

summary.description: One sentence a person can read: the verdict and when the check ran (UTC). Generated from decision and signal_keys; branch on those, not on this text.

settlement.description: Compliance attestation you can bind to your own settlement. OceanAlt never touches the funds.

attestation.description: Attestation token; pass it to GET /api/attestation/verify?token=…

attestation_id.description: Short reference to this decision, for settlement memos. Not a replay or single-use primitive.

bind.description: Human-readable instruction for attaching the attestation to a settlement.

rails.description: Settlement rails this attestation is commonly bound to (informational).

ApiKeyBearer.description: Optional registered API key (POST /api/access-keys). It raises limits; it is never required.

ApiKeyHeader.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyHeader.description: The same key, for clients that prefer a custom header.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Honoured on the payment call (no action) and on action rotate; ignored by preview and other actions. Same x-agent-secret + same key + same JSON body within 24 hours → original status and body with Idempotent-Replayed: true, nothing executed again, no threat recorded. Same key + different body → 422. Original still running → 409 with retry-after. Keep the same nonce when retrying. A UUID is recommended.
